From c99bf38960c2817158eb301097bb77755d6d3a0f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Codex <codex@localhost>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 03:40:32 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] Compare task projections before carrying committed candidate
 feedback

---
 experiments/openexempt_online.py  | 11 +++++++++--
 tests/test_openexempt_contract.py | 30 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 2 files changed, 39 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/experiments/openexempt_online.py b/experiments/openexempt_online.py
index 75a2386..3fddc4b 100644
--- a/experiments/openexempt_online.py
+++ b/experiments/openexempt_online.py
@@ -508,8 +508,15 @@ def candidate_feedback(decision, observations, origin, *, witness_limit=8):
     if decision.get("explicit_noop"):
         return None
     accepted = bool(decision.get("accepted"))
-    if accepted and decision.get("proposed_bank") == decision.get("candidate"):
-        return None
+    if accepted:
+        proposed, committed = decision.get("proposed_bank"), decision.get("candidate")
+        # Composition canonicalizes IDs and task blocks. Storage order alone is
+        # not an uncommitted edit and must not trigger another teacher proposal.
+        if proposed == committed or (
+                {s["id"] for s in proposed} == {s["id"] for s in committed}
+                and all(task_view(proposed, task) == task_view(committed, task)
+                        for task in FAMILIES)):
+            return None
     pool = decision.get("proposed_replay", decision.get("actual_replay", []))
     keys = [(r["case_id"], r["family"]) for r in pool]
     if len(keys) != len(set(keys)) or not set(keys) <= set(observations):
diff --git a/tests/test_openexempt_contract.py b/tests/test_openexempt_contract.py
index 7e181fe..3da4682 100644
--- a/tests/test_openexempt_contract.py
+++ b/tests/test_openexempt_contract.py
@@ -560,6 +560,36 @@ def test_reused_native_call_executes_new_body_and_never_reuses_answer_or_error(t
     assert len(study.native) == 1  # An old execution error is not a cached raw failure.
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("real_change", [None, "EC", "EV", "jurisdiction", "delete"])
+def test_candidate_feedback_compares_real_task_views_not_storage_order(real_change):
+    proposed = [
+        {"id": "z", "hypothesis_ids": ["EV", "EC"], "guidance": {
+            "by_task": [guidance("EV step", tasks=("EV",))["by_task"][0],
+                        guidance("EC step", tasks=("EC",))["by_task"][0]],
+            "operators": [], "jurisdiction": "ARIZONA"}},
+        {"id": "a", "hypothesis_ids": ["EC", "EV"],
+         "guidance": guidance("Shared step", jurisdiction="OREGON")},
+    ]
+    committed = compose_task_edits(proposed, proposed, ("EC", "EV"))
+    assert proposed != committed  # Both record and by_task ordering are normalized.
+    assert all(task_view(proposed, task) == task_view(committed, task)
+               for task in ("EC", "EV"))
+    if real_change in ("EC", "EV"):
+        block = next(b for b in committed[1]["guidance"]["by_task"]
+                     if real_change in b["tasks"])
+        block["procedure"] += " Changed actual guidance."
+    elif real_change == "jurisdiction":
+        committed[1]["guidance"]["jurisdiction"] = "ILLINOIS"
+    elif real_change == "delete":
+        committed.pop()
+    feedback = candidate_feedback({"accepted": True, "proposed_bank": proposed,
+        "candidate": committed, "actual_replay": []}, {}, {"synthetic": True})
+    if real_change is None:
+        assert feedback is None
+    else:
+        assert feedback["accepted"] and feedback["partially_committed"]
+
+
 @pytest.mark.parametrize("profile", ["program", "direct", "asset_refs"])
 def test_teacher_packet_is_bounded_but_current_sources_and_full_replay_are_not_dropped(
         monkeypatch, profile):
